healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Apify connector. Returns connector health status.

actors.list.title: List Actors
actors.list.description: List all Apify actors owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of actors to return (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Optional. Number of actors to skip for pagination.

actors.get.title: Get Actor
actors.get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Apify actor by its ID (e.g. username~actorName).

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID string.

actors.options.title: Actor Options
actors.options.description: List selectable actors for a picker: the account's own actors and saved tasks, plus Apify store results when a search term is supplied. Returns flat {id,label,source} options where id is the runnable actorId.

search.description: Optional. Store search term; when empty only account actors and tasks are returned.

actors.input_schema.title: Actor Input Schema
actors.input_schema.description: Fetch a specific actor's input schema (from its default build) so a UI can render the actor's runInput fields. Returns { schema } where schema is a JSON-Schema-style object.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

actor.run.title: Run Actor
actor.run.description: Start a new run of a specific Apify actor asynchronously. Returns the run object immediately without waiting for completion.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

runInput.description: Optional. The input JSON object to pass to the actor run.

memory.description: Optional. Memory limit for the run in megabytes (e.g. 256, 512, 1024).

timeout.description: Optional. Timeout for the run in seconds.

build.description: Optional. Tag or number of the actor build to run (e.g. 'latest').

maxItems.description: Optional. Maximum number of items the actor run should return.

actor.run_sync_get_dataset_items.title: Run Actor and Get Dataset Items
actor.run_sync_get_dataset_items.description: Run an Apify actor synchronously and immediately return the resulting dataset items. This is the primary 'scrape and get results' operation — it blocks until the actor finishes and returns all scraped data in one call.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

runInput.description: Optional. The input JSON object to pass to the actor (e.g. {"startUrls": [{"url": "https://example.com"}]}).

memory.description: Optional. Memory limit for the run in megabytes.

timeout.description: Optional. Timeout in seconds. Maximum 300 for synchronous runs.

build.description: Optional. Tag or number of the actor build to run.

maxItems.description: Optional. Maximum number of dataset items to return.

items.description: Array of scraped dataset items returned by the actor.

runs.get.title: Get Run
runs.get.description: Retrieve details and current status of a specific Apify actor run by its run ID.

runId.description: The unique ID of the actor run to retrieve.

run.description: The actor run resource including status, timing, and dataset info.

runs.list.title: List Actor Runs
runs.list.description: List all runs for a specific Apify actor, ordered by most recent first. Supports pagination.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of runs to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of runs to skip for pagination.

runs.abort.title: Abort Run
runs.abort.description: Abort a running Apify actor run. The run will be stopped and its status set to ABORTED.

runId.description: The unique ID of the actor run to abort.

run.description: The updated actor run resource with ABORTED status.

datasets.get.title: Get Dataset
datasets.get.description: Retrieve metadata and statistics for a specific Apify dataset by its ID.

datasetId.description: The unique ID of the dataset to retrieve.

datasets.items.title: Get Dataset Items
datasets.items.description: Retrieve items stored in a specific Apify dataset. Returns cleaned data in JSON format. Supports pagination.

datasetId.description: The unique ID of the dataset from which to retrieve items.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of items to skip for pagination.

tasks.list.title: List Tasks
tasks.list.description: List all Apify actor tasks owned by the authenticated user. Tasks are saved configurations for running actors with specific inputs.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of tasks to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of tasks to skip for pagination.

task.run.title: Run Task
task.run.description: Start a new run of a specific Apify actor task asynchronously. Returns the run object immediately.

taskId.description: The unique ID or username~taskName of the actor task to run.

runInput.description: Optional. Override input for this run. If omitted, the task's saved input is used.

task.run_sync_get_dataset_items.title: Run Task and Get Dataset Items
task.run_sync_get_dataset_items.description: Run an Apify actor task synchronously and immediately return the resulting dataset items. Blocks until the task run completes.

taskId.description: The unique ID or username~taskName of the actor task to run.

runInput.description: Optional. Override input for this run.

items.description: Array of dataset items returned by the task run.

key_value_store.get_record.title: Get Key-Value Store Record
key_value_store.get_record.description: Retrieve a single record (value) from an Apify key-value store by its store ID and record key.

storeId.description: The unique ID of the key-value store.

recordKey.description: The key of the record to retrieve (e.g. 'OUTPUT', 'INPUT').

value.description: The value stored at the given key. May be any JSON type or string.
